one_line: MIT-licensed HuggingFace dataset of 16.5M Airbnb reviews for Buenos Aires spanning 2011-2023 (9.48GB CSV/Parquet), well outside our 13-city panel and predating our Dec-2022 start.
abnb_use: Extends the reviews-based stays-index method (gap #1, historical pre-2023 coverage; gap #7, LatAm regional read) to a market and time window we do not hold.
sample_plan: Stream/download a capped slice of the Parquet file (e.g. first ~50k rows or one year of review dates) via the HF datasets library or direct HTTPS range request; cap total pull at ~5MB, well under the 25MB budget.
